bound: There is an IP rate limiter of 600 requests per 10s and 3000 per 60s. No application-level raw JSON body size cap was found; multipart is disabled but not relevant. Unknown API names fail before body parsing, so an existing API name is needed.
driver: attacker-controlled body byte volume, JSON nesting, and repeated requests to any existing API name
dynamic_probe: Use an existing API name such as system-time, invalid appid/sign, and controlled large/nested JSON bodies under bounded heap. Measure body read/parse memory, CPU, response time, limiter behavior and process health. Success requires sustained service unavailability or process failure, not a quick 4xx/JSON error.
entry: POST /gw/api/system-time?appid=<bad>&sign=<bad> with a large or deeply nested JSON body
impact: Plausible default unauthenticated request-burst DoS path, but static evidence alone cannot determine Tomcat body-size behavior, FastJSON failure mode, or whether the IP limiter keeps impact below service-unavailable threshold.
retention: request-local StringBuilder/String/FastJSON tree during parsing; may OOM before auth failure response
sink: ApiGateway.buildBaseApiContext calls ServletUtils.getRequestString(request) and JSON.parse(postData) before verfiy checks appid/sign/appSecret
source: raw request body on /gw/api/** plus query appid/sign
title: Unauthenticated API gateway parses raw JSON body before API signature verification
